name: quotedpart
description: Job-shop price estimates for machined parts from a STEP/IGES model or PDF drawing: cost breakdown, price breaks by quantity and a QuotedPart quote link.

interface.longDescription:
QuotedPart prices machined parts the way a job shop does. Give it a STEP or IGES model, a PDF drawing, or both, and it measures the part, picks a process (CNC milling, CNC turning, sheet laser or additive), builds the routing and returns a price breakdown: material, each machine operation with setup and run time, programming, finishing, extra charges and markup, at several quantities, with lead time. You can change the material, quantity or process and re-price without uploading again, and every estimate comes with a link that opens the quote on quotedpart.com.

Who it is for: engineers and buyers who want a fast should-cost for a part, and job shops checking a ballpark.

Limits: prices use QuotedPart's standard rates for the selected region (United States by default), not a binding quote from a shop. Parts must be single solid bodies or clear drawings; assemblies, weldments and drawings that leave sizes open come back as needing input. Files you price are stored by QuotedPart to build the quote, as described in its privacy policy.
capabilities: Price a part from a STEP/IGES model or PDF drawing
defaultPrompt: What would this STEP file cost to machine in 6061 aluminum, 25 pieces?
Compare 304 stainless and 6061 for this part at 10 and 100 pieces.
What's the unit price of this part at 1, 10 and 100 pieces in aluminum?

positive.description: Price a STEP model from a URL
positive.prompt: How much would this part cost to machine in 6061 aluminum, 25 pieces? https://quotedpart.com/samples/HX-1042%20mounting%20bracket.step
positive.expected_behavior: Returns unit price and line total in USD at 25 pcs with the cost lines (material, mill setups, programming), other quantity breaks, lead time and a quotedpart.com quote link; says it is an estimate at standard rates.

positive.prompt: Quote this bracket using its drawing for material and finish: model https://quotedpart.com/samples/HX-1042%20mounting%20bracket.step drawing https://quotedpart.com/samples/HX-1042%20mounting%20bracket.pdf
positive.expected_behavior: Prices the part with the material and finish read from the drawing (Al 6061, anodize), reports the drawing facts used and the quote link. If the drawing read is still running it calls get_quote and then reports.

positive.prompt: Price https://quotedpart.com/samples/HX-2210%20drive%20shaft.step in 6061, then tell me what it costs in 304 stainless instead.
positive.expected_behavior: First estimate in 6061, then update_estimate on the same quote_id with 304 stainless; shows both unit prices side by side.

positive.prompt: Which materials can QuotedPart price for CNC turning?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists material names (and ids) valid for cnc_turn in the default shop, without inventing any.

positive.prompt: What's the unit price of https://quotedpart.com/samples/HX-3307%20cover%20plate.step at 1, 10 and 100 pieces in aluminum?
positive.expected_behavior: One estimate with quantities 1, 10 and 100; table of unit prices showing setup cost spread over the lot; quote link.

negative.prompt: How much does a CNC bracket cost?
Price this spreadsheet for me: https://example.com/budget.xlsx
Order 50 of these brackets from a shop and pay with my card.

review.commerce_description: QuotedPart returns price estimates only. It does not sell parts, place orders or process payments.

publication.release_notes: First release: price a part from a STEP/IGES model or PDF drawing, compare materials and quantities, and open the quote on quotedpart.com.
